ex.t: 例如，你可能听到有人说：“今年冬天很冷，所以我不用为全球变暖担心。”另一个问题是，喧闹而紧迫的事被赋予过多重要性，使人们忽视了 arguably 更重要的长期趋势。

ex.t: 他很可能在修理桌子。

ex.s: Too often, when you stand up to give a speech, you focus on the “public” at the expense of the “speaking.”    17     Focus on the speaking.
ex.t: 很多时候，当你站起来演讲时，你只顾着“公众”而牺牲了“演讲”。    17     把注意力放在演讲上。

ex.s: Your sister is a good swimmer;surely you will be, too. ”What she refused to acknowledge, however, was that I was visibly afraid of water.
ex.t: 你姐姐游泳很好；你肯定也会的。然而，她不愿承认的是，我明显怕水。

ex.s: As darkness came over the field and the match ended, the goal keeper, Juan, walked over to me and said in a matter-of-fact way, “In your home, do you have a moon too?” I was surprised.
ex.t: 当夜幕笼罩球场、比赛结束，守门员胡安走到我面前，用一种就事论事的口气说：“在你们家，也有月亮吗？”我很惊讶。

ex.s: Her owners were sad too, but they knew their son would be back to visit.
ex.t: 它的主人也很伤心，但他们知道儿子会回来看望它。

ex.s: And this will make you feel good, too.
ex.t: 这也会让你感觉很好。

ex.s: Then, when I was in the five grade, I wanted to be a teacher because I liked my English teacher too much.
ex.t: 然后，当我上五年级的时候，我想成为一名老师，因为我非常喜欢我的英语老师。

defs.def: （用以强调生气、惊奇或同意等）

ex.s: I had been too nervous to pay attention when he introduced himself!
ex.t: 他们同意立即采取行动。
